description: Read a public web page supplied by the user or returned by search. Returns its title, URL, and main content as text, so you can answer from the full page instead of a snippet.

url.description: Address of the page to read, such as a link the user shared or a URL from search results

name: crawl

result.description: The page that was read; text holds its main content

id.description: Stable identifier for this result; for web results this is the canonical URL

text.description: Result snippet or extracted page text when available

url.description: Canonical URL that clients can cite and users can open

title: Read a web page
